grievances.symptom: Running 'wrangler whoami' or 'wrangler d1 execute --remote' without CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN attempts to open a local desktop browser and deadlocks headless agent stdin/stdout indefinitely.
grievances.workaround: Export CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID into process environment before invoking wrangler, or inspect token presence before running remote commands.

grievances.symptom: gcloud commands prompt 'Do you want to continue (Y/n)?' in headless terminal subprocesses, freezing execution until watchdog timeout.
grievances.workaround: Always append '--quiet' flag to every gcloud CLI invocation (e.g. 'gcloud compute instances stop <name> --quiet').

grievances.symptom: npx <package> prompts 'Need to install the following packages: <pkg>. Ok to proceed? (y)' in headless subprocess, hanging the agent.
grievances.workaround: Always pass the '--yes' flag: 'npx --yes <package> <args>'.

grievances.symptom: Tailwind CSS v4 removes '@tailwind base; @tailwind components; @tailwind utilities;'. Agents generated v3 CSS syntax resulting in un-styled raw HTML.
grievances.workaround: Replace CSS directives with '@import "tailwindcss";' and install '@tailwindcss/postcss' with postcss.config.mjs plugin '@tailwindcss/postcss': {}.

grievances.symptom: Next.js 15+ changed 'params' and 'searchParams' in page/layout/route handlers from synchronous objects to Promises. Sync access throws runtime Error: Route params should be awaited.
grievances.workaround: Update handler signature: 'export default async function Page({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) { const { id } = await params; }'.

grievances.symptom: Pydantic v2 removes model.dict() and class Config: orm_mode=True, raising PydanticUserError during model serialization.
grievances.workaround: Replace model.dict() with model.model_dump() and Config: orm_mode=True with model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True).

grievances.symptom: ESLint v9 deprecates .eslintrc.* legacy format. Running 'eslint .' fails with 'ESLint couldn't find an eslint.config.(js|mjs|cjs) file'.
grievances.workaround: Migrate to flat config 'eslint.config.mjs' exporting an array of configuration objects, or set ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG=false for legacy projects.

grievances.symptom: Cloudflare Pages Functions greedy catch-all router (functions/[[route]].js) intercepts GET requests for static CDN assets, returning 404 or 405.
grievances.workaround: In functions router, inspect request.method: if GET/HEAD, delegate immediately to 'env.ASSETS.fetch(request)'.

grievances.symptom: HTTP 204 No Content responses with 'Content-Type: application/json' header cause strict HTTP/MCP clients to fail parsing empty responses.
grievances.workaround: Separate CORS_ONLY headers (no Content-Type) for 204/202 from JSON_HEADERS (with Content-Type) used on 200 responses.

grievances.symptom: SQLite D1 does not allow ALTER TABLE to modify CHECK constraints. Adding an enum value causes SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_CHECK error on insert.
grievances.workaround: Perform standard SQLite table migration: CREATE TABLE new with updated CHECK constraint, copy rows, DROP old, and RENAME new to original.

grievances.symptom: FastMCP python sidecar on Windows can emit CRLF line endings on stdio transport, corrupting JSON-RPC framing in strict MCP clients.
grievances.workaround: Configure sys.stdout to binary write mode (sys.stdout.reconfigure(newline='\n')) or switch to remote Streamable HTTP transport.

grievances.workaround: Remove 'credsStore' from ~/.docker/config.json or pass explicit auth tokens to daemon.

grievances.symptom: [BUG] Interrupted RWLock acquisition releases a lock it never acquired

Target files: lib/crewai/src/crewai/utilities/rw_lock.py, lib/crewai/tests/utilities/events/test_rw_lock.py. `r_locked()` and `w_locked()` called acquire inside the `try` that always releases in `finally`. workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Editing a reusable credential can overwrite real secrets with masked placeholders

workarounds.symptom: Doc comments misattribute the token-endpoint TLS check to SEP-2207 (which is OIDC refresh / `offline_access`)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: docs(client): correct token endpoint TLS citation. Target files: .changeset/correct-token-endpoint-tls-citation.md, packages/client/src/client/auth.ts, packages/client/src/client/authErrors.ts. The JSDoc for `assertSecureTokenEndpoint` and `InsecureTokenEndpointError` attributed the token-endpoint TLS check to SEP-2207, which covers OIDC-flavored refresh-token guidance. This change points the explanation to the MCP authorization specification's HTTPS requirement and describes the SDK's loopback exemption ... (Ref: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk/pull/2768)

workarounds.symptom: Attribute-docstring inspection raises TypeError while cloudpickle reconstructs a local model in a fresh worker
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Handle `TypeError` gracefully during docstring extraction. Target files: pydantic/_internal/_docs_extraction.py. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13870. Catching the error is fine, as `cloudpickle` later restores the docstring (and actually the whole `FieldInfo` instances) directly from the pickled data. (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13874)

workarounds.symptom: Field(multiple_of=0) panics with an uncatchable PanicException instead of raising a user error
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Require `multiple_of` constraints to be positive. Target files: pydantic-core/src/validators/decimal.rs, pydantic-core/src/validators/float.rs, pydantic-core/src/validators/int.rs. Fixes https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13860. Also disallowing negative values (this is a breaking change in theory but there's no reason for users to do this, and they easily use a positive value instead) so that we don't emit invalid `multipleOf` JSON Schema values (that are required to be `> 0`). (Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/pull/13862)
